sources.title: Yacine Ikhlef, Jesper Lykke Jacobsen, and Hubert Saleur, A Temperley-Lieb quantum chain with two- and three-site interactions
sources.locator: Complete 9-page paper retrieved and inspected. Introduction, PDF pp. 1–2, identifies the loop-weight-2 isotropic spin-half chain and Heisenberg exchange.
